description: Turn your agent skill into a varg how to listing: reads a skill folder or repo, checks it against the varg media skill standard, fills the one card format every listing on varg how to (varg.ai/how-to) uses — name, one-line summary, use-when triggers, category, install command, a real example of the output — shows it to the person and publishes it for review through the varg MCP publish_skill tool (or the API with a varg key). Use when someone says "publish my skill", "list this skill on varg", "submit my skill to varg how to", "add my skill to the catalog", "how do I get my skill found by agents", or the same in any language. Not for finding a skill (use how-to-make-ai-video), not for writing the skill itself, and not for contributing to the vargHQ/skills repo (that is a pull request).
